reason: 建筑图框、出图布局和外参协作：按原始数值比例或实际单位设置普通视口出图比例。
purpose: 按原始数值比例或实际单位设置普通视口出图比例。

handle.description: 普通视口句柄；主视口及未知身份拒绝

scale.description: 原始纸空间/模型数值比例；与scale_denominator二选一

scale_denominator.description: 物理出图比例分母，如100表示1:100；自动换算模型单位及布局纸单位

model_units.description: 实际模型单位覆盖；null采用INSUNITS，仅在分母模式使用

limits: 分母模式：scale=每模型单位毫米数/每纸空间单位毫米数/分母。不会改尺寸/注释；未知单位和像素纸单位拒绝。原始scale模式保留兼容性。

name: weld_symbol
reason: 保留。建筑钢构、幕墙和金属栏杆节点可用焊缝符号；输入需来自节点设计。
purpose: 绘制焊接符号及尺寸说明。

x.description: X坐标。Kink X (WCS) — where the arrow line meets the reference line.

kind.description: Elementary symbol: square | v | bevel | u | j | fillet. [默认="fillet"]

size.description: Written before the symbol. A number on a fillet takes the ISO 2553 design-throat prefix (5 → 'a5'); pass a string for leg length ('z7'). [默认=null]

length.description: Weld length (mm), written after the symbol. [默认=null]

pitch.description: Pitch (mm) of an intermittent weld, written in brackets after the length. [默认=null]

side.description: arrow (symbol on the reference line) | other (on the dashed identification line) | both (symmetrical; the identification line is omitted, per ISO 2553:2019). [默认="arrow"]

field_weld.description: Flag at the kink: weld made on site. [默认=false]

all_around.description: Circle at the kink: weld all around. [默认=false]

process.description: Tail reference, e.g. an ISO 4063 process number. [默认=null]

leader_to.description: [x, y] on the joint; draws a leader with an arrowhead there. [默认=null]

rotation.description: Rotate the whole annotation about the kink (degrees CCW). [默认=0.0]

layer.description: 图层名称；具体为空或省略语义见后文。Override the role layers (DIM for geometry, TEXT for text). [默认=null]

limits: 输入焊缝类型和尺寸，不自动识别真实焊接构造

path.description: 文件路径；读写方向与后端限制见工具说明。Full path of the drawing to reference.

scale.description: 比例参数；不同工具含义不同，必须遵循本字段的具体说明。Uniform scale. [>0；默认=1.0]

rotation.description: Rotation in degrees, CCW from +X. [默认=0.0]

kind.description: 'attach' (the reference's own xrefs come with it) or 'overlay' (they do not, so a circular reference cannot form). [默认="attach"]

limits: 路径须可访问；外参内容并不成为可直接编辑的宿主实体
